text: I am kindly asking for your support of my motion to authorize the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) along Colin Avenue, between Eglinton Avenue West and Anderson Avenue. Residents of Colin Avenue submitted a petition to my office requesting the installation of speed humps to help reduce speeding, discourage cut-through traffic and improve the safety of their street. With the passage of this motion, the community will receive the traffic calming measures they have been organizing for.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (three speed humps) on Colin Avenue, between Eglinton Avenue West and Anderson Avenue, generally as shown in Attachment 2 to the letter (July 7, 2026) from Councillor Josh Matlow.
